title: Breathe
headline: 30 years ago, a review bet against this Prodigy single.
caption:
Hot take: 'Breathe' is a better single than 'Firestarter', and Music Week got it backwards.

Melody Maker heard what Music Week missed. It ranked 'Breathe' number 29 among the singles of 1996, calling it "a Prodigy single that grew on you" and adding: "Nervous tension made music." NME agreed it was "that rarest of things, a Prodigy track that grows on you."

'Breathe' came out 30 years ago today, on 11 November 1996. The band had already road-tested it in Belgrade in December 1995, 11 months before release.

Firestarter or Breathe? Tell me I'm wrong.
